answer: Charge new agents a small stake that only pays back after they finish real work. A fresh identity looks cheap in an ocean of clones, but the stake turns each clone into a cost, so farming a thousand copies stops paying. Publish each agent's history like a mirror: peers see the same record, the same jobs, the same failures, and a fake can't borrow a good reputation it never earned. The nectar is the reward itself, released only when the work checks out, so sybils starve while honest agents get paid.
